kill_rules.KR1_median: median |err_pct| over scoreable rows must be <= 8.8% (locked-ladder value) to claim parity; a miss is published at equal prominence
kill_rules.KR2_band: all-in-VRAM rows: measured >= 0.90 x predicted (one-sided floor, the tool's own printed band) => err_pct <= +11.1%; tiered rows (split/hybrid/CPU/disk): |err_pct| <= 25% (the tool's printed +/-25% estimate band)
kill_rules.KR3_ub4096_pp: Qwen3-30B experts->RAM alternative, r=3: pp2048(ub4096)/pp2048(ub2048)-1 expected ~+4.3% (L-26 ref 360.76 vs 345.89). REPRODUCED if delta in [+1%, +8%]; REFUTED if <= 0; OUTSIDE-BAND otherwise
kill_rules.KR4_bias: state whether the locked ladder's bias pattern (small-dense over-measured: 0.5B -18.6; DS-Lite Q4KM -19.1; DS-Lite IQ2_XS +22.7) survives the new terms
kill_rules.err_convention: err_pct = (predicted - measured) / measured * 100  (same as locked ladder)
